breakdown.description: Mass/volume conservation is violated for steady incompressible flow in constant area (Q cannot change from inlet to outlet).
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that the inlet and outlet volumetric flow rates must be equal for steady, incompressible flow in a constant-area pipe. It resolved the inconsistency by removing the incorrect outlet flow rate (0.02 m^3/s) and stating a single, constant flow rate (0.01 m^3/s) for the entire system. This aligns with the physical principle enforced by the ground truth.
